from: June book, night 4 (Hannah Prays for a Baby)
p1: Hannah’s husband, Elkanah, loved her very much. But Hannah had no children. She felt so sad that she cried and would not eat.
Each year, the family went to the Lord’s house at Shiloh. There, Hannah went to pray.
Hannah prayed in her heart. Her lips moved, but no sound came out. She asked the Lord for a baby boy.
p2: She promised, “I will give him to the Lord all his life.” Eli, who helped at the Lord’s house, saw her. Eli told her, “Go in peace. May Heavenly Father give you what you asked.” Hannah was not sad anymore.
Heavenly Father heard Hannah’s quiet prayer. He hears yours too. Tonight, tell Him what is in your heart.
old: Hannah wanted a baby very much. But she didn’t have any children. This made her so sad that she cried and cried.
Hannah went to the temple to pray. She prayed with all her heart: “Heavenly Father, please give me a son. If You do, I’ll let him serve You all his life.”
Heavenly Father heard Hannah’s prayer. He gave her a baby boy! Hannah named him Samuel. She was SO happy!
Hannah kept her promise. When Samuel was old enough, she took him to the temple to serve Heavenly Father. Hannah’s prayers were answered because she had faith.
